content.text: You can customize the color scheme by editing the CSS variables in `css/global.css`. The `--accent` variable controls the primary blue color used across the site.
The site uses Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and body text, JetBrains Mono for code, and Space Mono for the footer. These can be changed in the `global.css` variables.
Each page uses CSS Grid for layout. You can adjust column widths, spacing, and positioning by modifying the grid properties in the respective CSS files.
The site supports dark mode out of the box. Colors are defined using CSS variables that change based on the `data-theme` attribute. You can add new dark mode overrides in the CSS.
